messages:
omar: Heads up — planning RBAC change for onboarding service accounts tomorrow 09:00 PT. This will tighten KMS decrypt perms to role 'inference-runner' only. Expect CI jobs that use ephemeral keys to fail unless we update role binding.
anna: thanks for the heads up. which PR? need to update infra-roles and add audit logging.
omar: PR #4823. diff snippet:
```
resource "google_kms_key_ring_iam_binding" "inference" {
  role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
  members = ["serviceAccount:svc-onboard@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```
melissa: will SAST flag this? last time we saw build script acked secrets in images.
anna: SAST reported hardcoded creds in buildkite step on branch feature/onboard. CI bot attached the report.
ci-bot: CI SAST report: 2 findings -> path: infra/buildkite/pipeline.yaml line 23: 'GCP_SA_KEY' exposure. https://ci.redwood/4823/sast
omar: I'll rotate the ephemeral key and add KMS envelope usage + add audit_log=true in perms. Also will add a canary rollout for 2 hours.
security-bot: Note: RBAC changes require audit-log retention >=90d for compliance; add ticket SEC-2026.
anna: Add checklist item to PR description: 'update audit sinks, confirm decryption logs in stackdriver, update SAST suppression if false positive, add manual approval'.
melissa: I'm going to triage the SAST finding — likely false positive because the key is base64 kept in secret manager. will post remediation steps.
omar: thanks. tagging @sre-oncall for deploy window — we need minimal downtime. plan: 09:00-09:15 PT, rollback if >5% error rate.
mike-sre: acknowledged. will watch error budgets and alert on 5xx spike. please add runbook link.
anna: runbook: https://confluence.redwood/workflows/rbac-kms-rollout
melissa: quick remediation snippet to add to pipeline to avoid leakage:
```
- label: "Decrypt at runtime"
  command: |
    gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=<(echo $GCP_SA_KEY) --plaintext-file=- | jq -r .private_key > /tmp/gcloud_sa.json
    export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/tmp/gcloud_sa.json
```
melissa: I'll attach updated SAST comments and request reviewer from sec-reviewers.
omar: PR updated, linking SEC-2026 and #4823. rolling in canary tomorrow. :thumbsup: 
anna: thanks all. keep updates here if anything flakier than expected.
